summary: Settings first, because everything reads them. The limiter, the destination check and the analytics storage are independent of each other and run in parallel. A final task wires all three into the service, the API and the application factory.
test_strategy: Each building block is unit-tested in isolation with injected time; the wiring task adds API tests for the observable behaviour (429, 422, new statistics fields). The existing 127 tests are the regression net.

tasks.title: Hardening settings
tasks.description: Add settings for the per-minute creation and redirect limits and for the domain blocklist, read from the environment with safe defaults.

tasks.title: Token-bucket rate limiter
tasks.description: An in-memory token bucket per client key with bounded state and an injectable clock.

tasks.title: Destination vetting
tasks.description: Syntactic checks that refuse non-public, disguised, self-referencing and blocklisted destinations.

tasks.title: Visitor analytics storage
tasks.description: Migration 3 adds clicks.visitor_hash holding SHA-256 of the visitor's address and user agent; the repository stores it and aggregates unique visitors per day and clicks per referrer.

tasks.title: Wire limits, vetting and analytics into the service and API
tasks.description: Limiter dependencies on the create and redirect routes keyed by X-Forwarded-For or the socket address; destination check in URL validation; visitor hash and referrer host recorded on redirect; statistics extended; error mapping for 429 and unsafe destinations.
